body:
# 🏷️ 你的名字？ (Whats Ur Name?)

**用命名牌给朋友起个专属昵称吧！右键一下，备注到手——仅你自己看得见。**

---

### ✨ 主要功能

| 操作 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| **设置备注** | 铁砧里给命名牌取名 → 右键玩家，该玩家头顶/Tab/聊天名字变为昵称 |
| **取消备注** | 手持**空白**命名牌右键已设备注的玩家 |
| **不消耗命名牌** | 无限次使用，随便改 |
| **彩色昵称** | 命名牌上带 `§c` `§l` 等格式码的昵称完整保留 |
| **彩虹模式** | 名字前加 `##` 前缀（如 `##好朋友`），昵称自动循环彩虹色 |

### 🎯 替换位置

| 位置 | 效果 |
|:---|:---|
| 头顶名称标签 | ✅ 替换为备注名|
| Tab 列表 | ✅ 替换为备注名 |
| 聊天消息 | ✅ 朋友名字自动替换为备注名 |

### 🔧 兼容性说明

- **跨版本支持**：同时提供 Fabric 1.21.1、NeoForge 1.21.1、Forge 1.20.1 三版本
- **客户端独立**：纯客户端模组，服务器无需安装
- **存储位置**：`config/whatsurname/{服务器地址}/notes.json`，按服务器隔离
- **Fabric 依赖**：Fabric API (≥0.116.8)
- **NeoForge / Forge**：无额外依赖

---
**English Version**

## 🏷️ Whats Ur Name?

**Give your friends a nickname with a name tag!** Right-click to set a custom alias — visible only to you.

---

### ✨ Main Features

| Action | Description |
|:---|:---|
| **Set Nickname** | Name a name tag in an anvil → right-click a player to set their nickname |
| **Remove** | Right-click a nicknamed player with a **blank** name tag |
| **No Consumption** | Name tags are never consumed |
| **Color Support** | Full support for `§c` `§l` etc. formatting codes from the name tag |
| **Rainbow Mode** | Prefix with `##` (e.g. `##BestFriend`) for cycling rainbow colors |

### 🎯 What Gets Replaced

| Location | Effect |
|:---|:---|
| Name Tag (above head) | ✅ Replaced with nickname (rainbow mode animates) |
| Tab List | ✅ Replaced with nickname |
| Chat Messages | ✅ Friend's name auto-replaced |

### 🔧 Compatibility Notes

- **Multi-Loader**: Available for Fabric 1.21.1, NeoForge 1.21.1, and Forge 1.20.1
- **Client-Only**: Works on the client side only — no server installation needed
- **Storage**: `config/whatsurname/{server}/notes.json`, isolated per server
- **Fabric**: Requires Fabric API (≥0.116.8)
- **NeoForge / Forge**: No additional dependencies
